answer_span_consistency.note: passed: accepted answers do not repeat the visible slot prefix

target_fidelity.note: Uses negative past perfect continuous active form: “had not been sleeping.”

grammaticality.note: The completed sentence is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The cause-and-effect context is natural and coherent.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It directly elicits the specified verb form in a clear context.

determinacy.note: The verb, polarity, tense-aspect form, and blank location clearly determine the accepted responses.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: Vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving requires only the stated negative past perfect continuous form.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is needed.
